AND order_goods_time BETWEEN #{param.endDateTime} and #{param.startDateTime}

select og.order_id, og.order_goods_num, og.order_goods_returnnum, og.order_goods_commission, og.goods_member_discount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og where og.order_id = #{orderId} AND og.order_goods_returnnum > 0
select count(1) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog where oog.order_id = #{orderId} and (oog.goods_return_status != 0 or oog.goods_refund_status != 0 or oog.goods_barter_status != 0)
select goods_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods where order_id = #{orderId} and (goods_return_status != 0 or goods_refund_status != 0 or goods_barter_status != 0)

select og.goods_id, og.common_id, og.goods_name, og.common_id, og.goods_price, og.order_goods_num, og.goods_image, og.order_spec_chineseValue as goodsSpec, og.ver_id, og.barter_goods_id, og.order_goods_returnnum, og.order_spec_chineseValue, og.goods_refund_status, og.goods_barter_status, oor.return_method_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oob.order_id = og.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor on oor.order_id = og.order_id where og.order_id = #{orderId}
and ((oob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND oob.original_order IS NULL) or( oob.deliver_shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND oob.original_order IS NOT NULL))
and ((oob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND oob.original_order IS NULL) or( oob.deliver_shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND oob.original_order IS NOT NULL)) and oor.return_type = 3
and og.goods_barter_status != 0
select if(jd_son_order_id is null, jd_order_id, jd_son_order_id) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods where order_id = #{orderId} and goods_id = #{orderGoodsId}
